omitted_conditional_variant.reason: Same ending directions as the overall default, which remains unconditioned.

collection.score_definition: Mean across all other cohort members of same-fit after + half-tie frequency; four settings normalized separately then equally weighted. Lower is earlier. No min-max rescaling.
collection.variant_selection: Filter full-reference group-median directions first, then minimize objective within each representation/penalty/sample. Missing eligible samples are reported, never replaced.
collection.interpretation: Descriptive consensus, not a probability, elapsed time, unique chronology, or one actual fitted curve. Page and bifolium scores use different peer populations.
